issues.description: The type of the StockIngredient.price is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement's UML and method signatures specify price as int (StockIngredient(String, int, int) and -price: int), the template StockIngredient.java defines price as a double (constructor takes double and getPrice() returns double), while the solution uses int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected type and will cause type/return-value inconsistencies when implementing or testing methods like acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice which are specified to use int price.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the price type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the template StockIngredient to use an int price (field, constructor parameter, and getPrice() return type) to match the UML and the solution, or update the problem statement and solution to use double everywhere. Ensure acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice signatures and usages align with the chosen type.
